ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from changing status from 'ID Ops: Daon Approved' to 'Daon Failed'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "ID_Ops_Assistance", ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "ID Ops: Daon Approved"), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Daon Failed" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the status from 'ID Ops: Daon Approved' to 'Daon Failed'.
